title: Mediterranean Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread with a Mediterranean twist. Perfect for a quick snack or as a side dish.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the kneadable flour, salt, and pepper.
Gradually add the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal portions, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Brush the flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle with feta cheese, kalamata olives, and fresh parsley.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
